description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator class, which implements menu configuration logic for performance tracking screens within the OrangeHRM system's HR module. It dynamically overrides the screen based on the request query parameter, specifically for 'my' mode performance tracking list view.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for performance tracker log screens, allowing dynamic screen overrides based on request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen for performance tracking based on the request's 'mode' parameter.
